mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity valuations, increasing the present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is persistent and holds across all monetary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 20-period moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity and corporate earnings growth, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This relationship is persistent across all supply regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300 thousand units signal a contracting housing market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1300, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both rise, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
